claims.statement_plain_english: Every authorization has a valid context and an amount in [0, remaining] within the original signed-64-bit charge.
Every authorized reason is one of the three approved exact labels.
Every ineligible context or modeled response returns Rejected and an empty plan.
Every eligible proposal is accepted with its exact amount, reason, and caller-bound intent.
The pure source boundary returns exactly one caller-bound intent iff authorized; otherwise no intent.

assumptions: Dafny mathematical integers, finite strings and sequential pure calls; all typed contexts and responses are covered.
No model accuracy assumption; allowed reason membership does not establish factual truth.
Host data truth, authentication, atomic remaining-balance reservation and durable payment idempotency are external obligations.
Source proof does not cover compilation, parsing, clocks, scheduling, transport, effect dispatch, persistence or deployment.
